title: BlazeSpawnerLock
description: Simple Minecraft paper 1.21.x plugin that locks the modification of blaze spawners by the players to keep SMPs alive
body:
# BlazeSpawnerLock Simple minecraft paper 1.21.x plugin that locks the modification of blaze spawners by the players to keep SMPs alive ## Configurable Settings This plugin offers a configurable message displayed when a player tries to break a blaze spawner ## Compatibility Version: **1.21.x** (wider support planned)
**Bukkit** ✅**Spigot** ✅**Paper** ✅**Purpur** ✅**Folia** ❌ (planned) ## Permissions **blazespawnerlock.bypass** - bypass the plugin and allow players with the permission to break spawners (default: op)
**blazespawnerlock.reload** - reload the plugin configuration (default: op) ## Commands **/blazespawnerlock reload** - reload the plugin configuration
**/blazespawnerlock update** - check for plugin update
**/bsl** - alias for default command ## Planned Features - **1.20-1.21.x** Support
- Per-World Configuration
- Security Updates if Needed
